title: Ueberkinger Modpack
description:
Das offizielle Überkinger Modpack zum Server. GLHDF


En. Official Ueberkinger Community Modpack. It's purpose is to keep the game as vanilla as possible but improve performance, looks and overall QOL but still beeing able to be played vanilla if wanted.
body:
Vanilla Modpack für den Überkinger-Server. Alles kann, nichts muss. Performance und QOL-Mods für ein erfüllteres Vanilla Erlebniss. 

En. Official Community Modpack for Ueberkinger Community. Only slight Vanilla enhancment. The main purpose of the pack is to improve performance and enhance the vanilla experience. It includes proximity chat, shaders and Ambient Sounds to give the players more possibilitys in roleplay. It aims to improve the vanilla server experience but makes sure that no players without mods are excluded.
